hero.headingPart1: Becoming a trusted distribution company with one operational
hero.desc: Official nationwide distributor of mobile phones and smart tech devices. Growing brands through honesty, accurate data, and reliable fulfillment across Indonesia.

directory.heading: 17 Regional Offices & Depots
directory.desc: Supplying retail stores and partners through a robust network of headquarters, logistics warehouses, and regional depots across Greater Jakarta, Java, Sumatra, and Sulawesi.

missions.heading: Five core missions of Phone Distribution.

items.title: Transparency & Integrity
items.desc: Conducting distribution transparently, fairly, and responsibly toward customers, principals, and partners across every business transaction.

items.title: Superior Supply Execution
items.desc: Achieving outstanding sales and distribution performance through rigorous execution, accurate inventory data, and consistent operational standards.

items.title: Long-Term Partnerships
items.desc: Building enduring relationships with clients while cultivating a respectful, safe, and empowering work environment for our teams.

items.title: Continuous & Scalable Growth
items.desc: Expanding organizational capacity, geographic reach, and team capabilities systematically alongside brand growth.

items.title: Commitment & Complete Accountability
items.desc: Fulfilling every delivery promise, commercial agreement, and after-sales service with complete accountability and punctuality.

pillars.heading: Four core pillars of distribution operations.

items.title: Logistics & Warehousing
items.desc: Centralized stock management at regional depots paired with secure delivery fleets ensuring cargo safety and timeliness.

items.title: Official Principals
items.desc: Smartphone brand partnerships managing product allocations, official warranties, and regional promotional campaigns.

items.title: Data-Driven Systems
items.desc: Real-time monitoring of market demand patterns and regional inventory levels to minimize stockouts.

items.title: Dealer Support
items.desc: Fast ordering channels, transparent commercial terms, and on-the-ground support to help retail partners thrive.
